description: React component for managing user language settings in Mattermost, including language selection dropdown, event handling, and API interactions.

classes.name: ManageLanguage
classes.description: React component class for managing user language preferences.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds event listener for keydown events on the select container.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listener for keydown events on the select container.

methods.name: handleContainerKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for the container, specifically ESC to close menu.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for opening the menu with ENTER.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Updates component state with selected language option.

methods.name: changeLanguage
methods.description: Triggers language change process, updates user profile.

methods.name: submitUser
methods.description: Sends user profile update request, handles loading and error states.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the language selection UI and related messages.
